template.title: The Happy Toy and the Kind Friend
template.summary: A child finds a sad toy, decides to help it, and together they bring joy to the playground.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_pet]] in the [[slot_place]].
One sunny day, they saw a [[slot_color]] [[slot_toy]] that looked sad.
The toy was lonely because it had no friends to play with.
[[slot_child]] thought, 'Maybe I can make it happy.'
[[slot_child]] wondered if they should just leave the toy alone, but they chose to help.
First, [[slot_child]] tried to sing a song, but the toy stayed quiet.
Then [[slot_child]] brought a [[slot_snack]] to share, hoping the toy would smile.
The toy's eyes twinkled, and it started to hum like a tiny drum.
That humming made the whole playground light up with a soft glow.
[[slot_child]] decided to invite the [[slot_pet]] to play with the toy.
Together, they played [[slot_activity]] and the toy laughed, humming louder.
The [[slot_color]] toy glowed brighter, like a sunrise on a cloud.
When the sun set, the toy said, 'Thank you, friend,' and they all went home happy.
